explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/461: with s_t(n) the product (with multiplicity) of the primes p < t dividing n, and f(n,t) the number of distinct values of s_t(m) for m ∈ [n+1, n+t], is f(n,t) ≫ t uniformly in n and t? smoothComponent and f match these definitions. The statement asks for an absolute c > 0 with c·t ≤ f(n,t) for all n, t. The edge case t = 0 is trivial. Faithful.
